_comment: Shot list for episode 3. Each shot starts at the section id in 'from' and holds until the next. Shared images (scroll, Brian's pew) are reused from episode 1. 'description' is the written description for blind viewers and the episode notes.
style: Painterly oil-sketch look, cool early-morning light warming through the episode, first-century Bethsaida: a fishing village on the north shore of the Sea of Galilee, stone houses, boats, nets, reeds, the lake wide and still. No faces shown close up; figures seen from behind or at a distance. No text in the image. No modern objects. 16:9.

shots.prompt: Two men walking away from a lakeside village onto open grassy ground, one leading the other by the hand, seen from behind, the lake wide and silver on the right, early morning light, boats pulled up on the shore in the distance.
shots.description: Two men walk away from a lakeside village onto open ground, one leading the other by the hand, the lake silver to the right.

shots.prompt: A narrow lane in a small fishing village of black basalt stone houses, nets hung to dry on wooden racks, a goat, baskets of fish, a woman carrying water seen from behind, the lake glimpsed at the end of the lane, morning light.
shots.description: A narrow lane of dark stone houses with nets drying on racks, a goat, baskets of fish, and the lake at the end of the lane.

shots.card: A blind man in a town like that
shots.prompt: A man in a plain robe walking confidently alone along a village lane with one hand trailing a stone wall, villagers going about their work around him, net racks, a doorway, warm morning light, seen from behind.
shots.description: A man walks alone along a village lane, one hand trailing the wall, villagers at work around him.

shots.card:
Not By Sight
Episode 3: The blind man at Bethsaida
shots.prompt: Title card background only: the Sea of Galilee at dawn from the north shore, reeds in the foreground, a few fishing boats far out, low hills across the water, mist on the surface, no people, no text, lower third calm.
shots.description: Title card over the Sea of Galilee at dawn, reeds and distant boats: Not By Sight, episode three, the blind man at Bethsaida.

shots.prompt: A wooden fishing boat on open lake water with a dozen men aboard seen from behind and above, one standing and speaking, the others seated and listening, oars shipped, grey-blue morning water, the shore ahead.
shots.description: A fishing boat on open water with a dozen men aboard, one standing to speak, the shore ahead.
The open scroll in warm light. The Scripture reader begins.

shots.card: Having eyes, do you not see?
shots.description: The boat again, the men listening.
The open scroll. The healing at Bethsaida.

shots.prompt: A gravel lake shore with fishing boats drawn up, nets spread to dry, stone weights and wooden floats, a fisherman mending a net seen from behind, the village's stone houses behind, gulls, morning light.
shots.description: Boats drawn up on a gravel shore, nets spread to dry with stone weights, a fisherman mending a net, gulls.
The open scroll. The woes on the towns.

shots.card: A town that had seen so much
shots.prompt: A small lakeside town of stone houses seen from the grassy slope outside it, looking back, its lanes quiet, the lake beyond, a long shadow across the foreground, late morning light, no people near.
shots.description: The small town seen from outside, looking back at its quiet lanes, the lake beyond.

shots.prompt: Villagers hurrying down a slope toward a boat just landing on the shore, a man guiding a friend by the arm among them, all seen from behind, the boat's prow on the gravel, men stepping into the shallows, bright morning.
shots.description: An imagined scene. Villagers hurry down to a boat just landed, one man guiding a friend by the arm.

shots.prompt: Two men walking out of the village onto grass, the one in front holding the other's hand and leading, the crowd left behind at the edge of the houses, the lake on the right, seen from behind and a little above, soft light.
shots.description: Two men walk out of the village onto grass, hand in hand, the crowd left behind, the lake to the right.

shots.prompt: A man standing on open grass with his back to us, arms slightly lifted, looking out at the wide Sea of Galilee in full morning light, hills across the water sharp and clear, a second figure beside him, no faces.
shots.description: A man stands on the grass with his back to us, arms lifted a little, looking out at the whole lake in clear light.
The white cane leaning against a church pew. Brian speaks.
The boat again. Mark's point about who was really blind.
The white cane and the pew. Brian speaks.

shots.prompt: A soft, blurred painterly view of a few tall figures standing on a shore seen as indistinct shapes against bright water, their outlines soft like trees, no faces or detail, hazy light.
shots.description: A blurred view: tall indistinct figures on a shore against bright water, their outlines soft like trees.

shots.card:
For we walk by faith, not by sight.
2 Corinthians 5:7

blindnessinthebible.com
shots.prompt: The Sea of Galilee at dusk from the north shore, boats pulled up for the night, a few lamps in the village, deep blue sky with first stars, no people, no text, lower third calm and dark.
shots.description: Closing card over the lake at dusk, boats pulled up and lamps in the village: For we walk by faith, not by sight. The site address.
